summary: Frontend regression testing completed for login, menu add-item, order reject and accept, stock toggle, all workspace routes, mobile navigation, and responsive overflow.
action_items: Replace the intentionally MOCKED in-memory services with production integrations before launch; current state is lost on reload by design.
critical_code_review_comments: All tested interactions are local state flows; frontend/src/services/index.js remains MOCKED and is not consumed by App.js, so no real persistence or backend failure handling is covered.
seed_data_creation: None; used the existing seeded mock orders and menu items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login, add-item save, explicit rejected detail and queue synchronization, accept action, stock toggle, all routes, mobile orders navigation, and horizontal overflow at 375/768/1024/1440px were verified.
rca of the issue: No unresolved frontend defects reproduced. A first automated pass checked the queue immediately during React state batching and saw a transient stale row; an authenticated rerun with a short stabilization wait confirmed the queue status and new-order filter update correctly.
